tools.description: Create a social post draft on one or more of this connection's channels (ids from social_list_accounts — never invent them). Optionally pass a `delivery` (queue | prioritise | now | at) to send it on in the same call. With publish rights the delivery is carried out: scheduled, queued or published. Without them, or when the workspace requires approval, the post goes to BrightBean Review, where a person approves it; approving carries the delivery out. The result says which happened. A time must carry its offset (2026-10-06T09:00:00+02:00). `linkUrl` is where the post points (an http(s) address). Only Pinterest acts on it today — every other channel ignores it — so set it when a pin should send the reader somewhere, and leave it out otherwise rather than repeating a link that is already in the caption. `perAccount[<accountId>]` overrides one channel (`caption`, `title`). A `firstComment` on a channel that can't take one is refused, never dropped. `perAccount[<accountId>].options` sets that network's own settings (TikTok privacy, YouTube visibility and tags, …); its schema is on the channel in social_list_accounts. Pass `idempotencyKey` (any string you choose) so a retry never does the work twice.

accounts.description: The channels to post to. Every one must be allowed for this key.

queueIds.description: Which queue each channel's post joins: social account id → queue id, or null for the channel's Main queue. A channel left out goes to its queue for the post's category, else Main.

delivery.description: Schedule, queue or publish in the same call. Without publish rights, or when the workspace requires approval, this sends the post to Review, labelled with this key; approving it carries the request out.

firstComment.description: Posted as the first comment. Refused (422) for a channel that can't take one.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key. A write returns the first result for 24 hours.

linkUrl.description: Where the post points (a Pinterest pin's link).

perAccount.description: Per-channel overrides, keyed by channel id.

proposedPublishAt.description: A proposed publish time for the draft (ISO 8601 with an offset). A note only: nothing is queued, scheduled or published because of it, and scheduling, queueing or publishing the post clears it. A `delivery` in the same call wins: carried out directly, the proposal ends up empty; sent to Review with a time, the proposal becomes that time. `null` means none.

title.description: A title, for channels that take one.
